title: runtime/bindings
description: Role-bindings file contract (feature 002, specs/002-model-endpoints; FR-003/FR-010, UR-MOD-013/017). Matches the live profiles/bindings.yaml shape: bindings maps a semantic role (rimbrain.plan, rimbrain.select, rimbrain.review, rimbrain.embed, ...) to {endpoint, model}; degraded_paths maps a role to an ordered fallback list tried when the primary fails or lacks capability. Degraded-path entries are either 'endpoint_id:model' references (first colon splits; model ids may themselves contain colons, e.g. 'openrouter:nvidia/foo:free') or bare terminal sentinels (rules, rules-only, skip, lexical-bm25) that resolve as non-endpoint fallbacks. Every endpoint id referenced here must exist in endpoints.yaml; the registry fails closed at load otherwise. Bindings are runtime state, not policy: editing never mutates an active RimBrain pack. schema_version optional; absent means 0.

schema_version.description: Contract revision; optional in v0 files (absent == 0).

bindings.description: role -> {endpoint, model, options?}. Roles resolve independently.

degraded_paths.description: role -> ordered fallback hops: 'endpoint:model' refs or terminal sentinel tokens (rules, rules-only, skip, lexical-bm25, ...).

model.description: Model id served by that endpoint.

options.description: Optional per-binding call options (temperature, max_tokens, ...); adapter-defined.
